title: Cultural Competence in Context: A Large Language Model Passes the Turing Test in Finland
abstract: arXiv:2609.18394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report the results of a Turing Test conducted in Finland in the Finnish language. Because languages and cultural contexts are unevenly represented in LLM training data, we expected the model (ChatGPT 5.2) to perform worse in a Finnish-language Turing Test than in previously studied English-language US contexts. We also present model-generated role prompting as a replicable technique for conducting comparative LLM-based Turing Tests designed to improve construct validity. Contrary to our expectations, the LLM passed the Finnish Turing Test. A prominent source of error was participants' reliance on linguistic cues, particularly colloquial Finnish, as markers of human authorship. We reframe the Turing Test from a test of intelligence to a comparative method for examining whether an AI system can display credible membership in a particular social world. Because its outcome reflects model capabilities, prompted identity, insider competence

translated_title: 语境中的文化能力：一个大语言模型在芬兰通过图灵测试
translated_abstract: 我们报告了在芬兰使用芬兰语进行的一项图灵测试的结果。由于语言和文化语境在大语言模型训练数据中的代表性不均衡，我们预期该模型在芬兰语图灵测试中的表现会差于此前研究的美国英语语境。我们还提出了模型生成的角色提示作为一种可复制的技术，用于开展基于大语言模型的比较性图灵测试，以提高构建效度。与我们的预期相反，该大语言模型通过了芬兰语图灵测试。一个显著的错误来源是参与者依赖语言线索，尤其是芬兰口语，将其作为人类作者身份的标志。我们重新界定了图灵测试，将其从一种智力测试转变为一种比较方法，用于检验人工智能系统能否在特定的社会世界中展现出可信的成员资格。因为其结果反映了模型能力、被提示的身份、内部人能力
tldr: 该研究在芬兰以芬兰语开展图灵测试，发现ChatGPT 5.2出乎意料地通过了测试，作者据此将图灵测试重新定义为检验AI能否在特定社会世界中展现可信成员资格的比较方法，并提出模型生成的角色提示作为可复制的研究技术。
en_tdlr: A large language model unexpectedly passed a Finnish-language Turing Test conducted in Finland, prompting the authors to reframe the Turing Test as a comparative method for examining whether an AI system can display credible membership in a particular social world, while introducing model-generated role prompting as a replicable technique.
